I'll start by saying that the vet who bathes the dogs does an excellent job. However, I believe it's important for businesses to receive constructive criticism, so my opinion is that the receptionist is very rude from the moment she answers the phone until she starts attending to customers. As a customer, it's important not only to receive good service but also good customer service. It's worth mentioning that this is the third time we've dealt with the receptionist, and all three times she has been extremely rude. Finally, I think you need to address the odor issue, as the entire establishment smells strongly of cat litter. I believe the vet's otherwise good service is significantly affected by these two issues, and if you can resolve them, customers will be able to speak of a great experience instead of just good service.
This place is great!!! They did such a great job with grooming my cocker spaniel & he really enjoys going there. They offer a variety of healthy treats & food for your pets. I recommend them 100%!!

The variety of products and prices are incredible! I haven't found better prices anywhere else. However, what stands out most is their customer service. Mrs. Maricela always attends to us with exceptional kindness and warmth. In addition to their great line of food, they also have toys and accessories for your pets, a very professional grooming/veterinary clinic, and much more. As a final bonus, they are also open on Sundays, which is very convenient for those of us who sometimes don't have time during the week. In short, a very good place for your pets.
